clusterSwitcher.label: Cluster

overview.title: No cluster connected yet
overview.description: Install the WatchLog agent on a Kubernetes cluster or Docker host. Within a minute this page shows cluster health, problems that need attention and recent warnings.

nodes.title: No nodes reporting
nodes.description: Nodes appear here as soon as the agent runs on them. Each node shows CPU, memory, disk, pod count and conditions.

workloads.title: No workloads to show
workloads.description: Connect a Kubernetes cluster to see Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs and their pods, including restart reasons such as OOMKilled.

docker.title: No Docker hosts connected
docker.description: Run the WatchLog agent with one docker run command on each host. Hosts and their containers, grouped by Compose project, appear here.

serviceMap.title: No traffic recorded yet
serviceMap.description: The service map is built from network traffic captured by the agent. After a cluster is connected, it shows which workloads talk to each other within about two minutes.

alerts.title: No alerts yet
alerts.description: Default alert rules such as CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled and node pressure turn on automatically when a cluster connects. Add Slack, Telegram, email or a webhook to receive them.

installLabel.kubernetes: Run once, from a checkout of the WatchLog repository, where helm reaches the cluster

installHint.docker: The command works on Linux hosts with Docker Engine 20.10 or newer. It mounts host paths read-only and adds no extra privileges.
installHint.kubernetes: Creates the watchlog namespace and labels it for the privileged PodSecurity level (the node agent mounts host paths read-only), then installs the node agent DaemonSet and the cluster-agent with read-only RBAC (no Secrets, ConfigMaps or nodes/proxy). Charts are not published yet, so helm uses the chart in deploy/helm.

hints.FailedGetResourceMetric: The metrics API (metrics.k8s.io) is not installed: install metrics-server, or remove the HPA.
hints.FailedComputeMetricsReplicas: The HPA can't read its metrics: install metrics-server, or check the HPA's metric names.
hints.FailedScheduling: No node fits the pod: check its requests, node selectors, taints and free capacity.
hints.FailedMount: A volume couldn't be mounted: check the Secret, ConfigMap or PVC it refers to.
hints.FailedAttachVolume: The volume couldn't attach: it may still be attached to another node.
hints.Unhealthy: A probe is failing: check the probe's path and port, and the app's startup time.
hints.BackOff: The container keeps exiting: open the pod for its last exit code and logs.
hints.ErrImagePull: The image couldn't be pulled: check the image name, tag and registry credentials.
hints.ImagePullBackOff: The image couldn't be pulled: check the image name, tag and registry credentials.
hints.FailedCreatePodSandBox: The pod's network couldn't be set up: check the CNI plugin on that node.
hints.Evicted: The node ran short of memory or disk and evicted the pod.
hints.OOMKilling: The kernel killed a process for memory: raise the memory limit or find the leak.
hints.FailedToCreateEndpoint: An Endpoints object with this name already exists: usually harmless after a Service is re-created.
hints.ClusterIPNotAllocated: Kubernetes repaired a Service's cluster IP: usually harmless.
hints.DNSConfigForming: The node's resolv.conf has too many search domains or nameservers.
hints.NodeNotReady: The node stopped reporting: check the kubelet and the node's network.
